Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - CC/1328/2025

Dear Mr. Dutta,

Thank you for meeting us on 5 June 2025 about your dispute with M/s Krishnan Constructions. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 3,69,00,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
